text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I escort Inari One to the infirmary after
she gets
injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a break, it's only a li'l scrape! A
little spit
and grit and I'll be as good as
new!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I can't be sittin' on my butt all day. Let's
hurry and
get back to trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you talkin' about? I'm tellin' ya
I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Geez. Never took ya for such a
worrywart!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, do you have to sit next to me with that gloomy expression? Fine... I'll take the day off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One goes back to her dorm with a
miserable
look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I told ya not to worry! Right, time to get
my head
back in the game!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I only tasked her with a light
run to
check her condition, Inari One's
face contorts
with pain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so the pain's back... but I can still
work
through it, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess you've got a point. Best to do as I'm told and play it smart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I cut our training session short,
Inari One
slumps her shoulders and
trudges back to the
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Howzat, Boss? No problem if I just
keep it
light, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Howzat, Boss? No problem if I just
keep it
light, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Edo girl, born and bred! No way a
li'l injury
like this'll stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While monitoring her injury, Inari One
completes
a light training session.
